scores.reason: It identifies a general mechanism, that the conservation list rather than the static symmetry selects the dynamic universality class, and pins it with a resolvable z separation plus a static-class consistency check.

The asserted unit-slope log-ratio symmetry of the entropy-production distribution is an exact identity of the steady state, tested here with a tolerance, and no declared component change alters the predicted slope.
A prospective quantitative claim that a one-unit change in order-parameter dimension shifts nu by more than a stated percentage and standard-error bar, with a null shift physically available.

The equality of the path-probability-ratio and housekeeping-heat routes to the entropy production rate is an exact identity of the dynamics, here checked as a numerical consistency with a drive-off null attached.

It asserts a closed-form scaling relation between eta and gamma/nu and tests it through two estimators built on disjoint moments, so the predicted agreement is an identity rather than a fitted number.
It claims the extrapolated Binder cumulant is a class invariant independent of any critical-coupling estimate, which is a structural statement about what universality fixes, with a hard pairwise bar.

It ties an integer invariant, the count of independent local conserved densities, to the integrability-breaking strength and demands integer stability under two independent perturbations of the estimator.

Constant scale-to-scale flux together with a single power-law spectrum over a frozen band of declared width is the structural inertial-range picture, and the frozen endpoints forbid rescuing it by narrowing the band.
It makes the ballistic transport weight the invariant marker of integrability, requiring both a finite measured plateau at epsilon = 0 and a threefold suppression at the top rung.

It asserts that the linearized blocking map in a truncated basis reproduces the finite-size-scaling nu and does so independently of the block factor, a structural claim about the map whose truncated implementation is not forced to agree.
It claims anomalous, nonlinear-in-p structure-function scaling as a general feature of the driven state, with separate bars for the deviation size and for its monotone growth in p.

A prospective quantitative claim that the measured fluctuation-dissipation ratio departs from its equilibrium value by a stated amount in the aging arm and not in the equilibrated control, with a linearity check on the response.
It claims the conservation list sets the coarsening growth exponent, a mechanism-level statement, and separates failure of the power-law form from a merely small inter-arm gap.

It posits a threshold in a continuously varying interaction-range exponent across which nu jumps and within whose sides nu is flat, which is a structural claim about where a class boundary sits and is risked in both directions.

It states the sufficiency of a four-item component list to fix nu and tests it on pairs simulated by different microscopic rules, with blinded labels and a second structurally different estimator route.

It registers a ranking-reversal prediction while predicting in advance that the two channels will tie within the bar, and it states in advance what a tie and a reversal each would license, making it a well-posed null.

It fixes numeric bars on the apparent conserved-charge count per channel at matched bit rate, plus a separate invariance bar on the slowest relaxation time, either of which can come out the other way.
A prospective claim of a task-dependent ranking reversal with a signed rank-correlation bar, a permutation test, and separate margins in zeta_6 and Brier score.

The live content is whether the cross-channel spread and the reversal survive a change of representation, but the companion claim that exponents are representation-independent follows from the declared exactness of the re-representation.

The collapse at full budget is close to forced by channel injectivity, but the load-bearing part, a saturation-budget ratio of at least sixteen between exponent estimation and extreme-event forecasting, is an open number with a stated failure value.
It predicts a specific nonzero, budget-shrinking non-commutation between coarse-graining and the exponent estimator, and declares in advance the two ways the constraint would instead be vacuous.

It proposes a structural split in which the approach of apparent entropy production to its microscopic value has a channel-dependent prefactor but a channel-independent power, and the fitted exponents can break that split.

It distinguishes a genuine ordering of experiments from a scalar score ordering and predicts the observable consequence of each, sign-consistent losses for nested channels and a task-dependent sign flip for incomparable ones, though the quantities compared are losses rather than anything a practitioner of this domain quotes.
It predicts both an order of failure among proposed survivors and a bounded effective-sample-size window in which the first failure occurs, and it forbids adjusting that window after the fact.

It predicts a named non-monotone loss-versus-budget cell with a size bar and a realization-tripling test that separates finite-sample from structural causes, but the measured quantity is estimator loss rather than a domain observable.

It names non-Gaussian tails of the local dissipation field as the mechanism behind the ranking reversal and deletes that source two independent ways, with the explanation falsifiable even if the effect survives.

A prospective quantitative claim that the cross-channel exponent spread collapses to an independently established bias floor when the correlation length is one lattice spacing and grows with the logarithm of scale separation.

It predicts a specific band-energy disagreement between two partially overlapping channels at low budget that closes at high budget, and declares in advance the values at which the constraint would be vacuous or unsatisfiable.
It commits to an explicit list of quantities invariant under every admissible channel and one that is not, so both an extra survivor and a violated bound count against it.

It puts numeric two-sided bars on both halves of a declared split, a cross-channel spread in nu above a measured bias floor and a much tighter spread in the transition location, with the reversed outcome explicitly counting against it.
